testcase.name: PublicBookingPage SSR guard (no window) > renders without throwing when there is no window global
PublicBookingPage > shows the offering details and grouped slots once loaded
PublicBookingPage > shows an error when the booking type fails to load
PublicBookingPage > shows a generic error message when loading fails with a non-API error
PublicBookingPage > falls back to a generic unavailable message when the load succeeds with no booking type and no error
PublicBookingPage > shows an empty state when there are no open slots
